newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's Corp launches new salads.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's Corp launches new salads.

text.p: McDonald's Corp said Friday it introduced a Grilled Chicken Salad Deluxe and revamped its garden salad. The new products are available at all of its U.S. restaurants.
The Grilled Chicken Salad Deluxe and the garden salad both feature radicchio, romaine and iceberg lettuce tossed with shredded carrots and croutons, McDonald's said.
The company also added a new Caesar dressing and a fat-free herb vinaigrette to its line of salad dressings.
McDonald's has more than 20,000 company-owned and franchised fast food restaurants worldwide.
Its stock closed up 3/8 Friday at 46.
